# SMV Step Simulator

Chapter 7 introduces SMV by simulating small models one `next()` step at a time. This notebook is a hands-on version of that same simulation loop for the three running examples of the chapter: the **flip-flop**, the **modulo-4 counter**, and the **five-digit mechanical counter** with carry propagation and a reset input.

Each click computes `next(v)` from the current valuation of every variable, exactly as the `ASSIGN` block specifies&mdash;there is no lookahead and no hidden state beyond what's shown.

```{=html}
<style>

}
.sm-lab {

  border: 1px solid var(--sm-border);

}
.sm-toggle {
  display: inline-flex;
  border: 1px solid var(--sm-border);

  margin-bottom: 14px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}
.sm-toggle button {
  border: none;

}

  border: 1px solid var(--sm-primary);
  background: var(--sm-primary);

}

  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px;
  font-family: ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.9rem; color: var(--sm-label);
}

  background: var(--sm-bg);
  border: 1px solid var(--sm-border);

}

  width: 44px; height: 54px;
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  border-radius: 8px;

  font-size: 1.4rem; font-weight: 700;
  background: #daf3fc; border: 2px solid #1f8fb7; color: var(--sm-text);
}
.sm-digit.carried { background: #ffe3b3; border-color: #e08a00; }
.sm-carry-label { font-size: 0.7rem; text-align: center; color: var(--sm-label); margin-bottom: 2px; }

<div class="sm-lab" id="nb25-w1">
  <div class="sm-toggle" id="nb25-model-toggle">
    <button data-model="flipflop" class="active">Flip-flop</button>
    <button data-model="mod4">Modulo-4 counter</button>
    <button data-model="mechcounter">Mechanical counter (5 digits)</button>
  </div>

  <div class="sm-code" id="nb25-code"></div>

  <div class="sm-controls">
    <button class="sm-btn" id="nb25-step">Step</button>
    <button class="sm-btn secondary" id="nb25-reset">Reset</button>
    <label class="sm-check-label" id="nb25-reset-ivar-wrap" style="display:none;">
      <input type="checkbox" id="nb25-reset-ivar"> push <code>reset</code> on next step
    </label>
  </div>

  <div class="sm-panel">
    <h4 style="margin:0 0 10px;font-size:0.85rem;color:var(--sm-label);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.04em;">Current state</h4>
    <div id="nb25-state-display"></div>
    <h4 style="margin:14px 0 6px;font-size:0.85rem;color:var(--sm-label);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.04em;">Trace</h4>
    <div class="sm-trace-strip" id="nb25-trace"></div>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
(function() {
  const CODE = {
    flipflop: `MODULE main
VAR   x : boolean;
ASSIGN
  init(x) := FALSE;
  next(x) := !x;`,
    mod4: `MODULE main
VAR   x : 0..3;
ASSIGN
  init(x) := 0;
  next(x) := (x + 1) mod 4;`,
    mechcounter: `MODULE cell(carry_in, reset)
VAR   value : 0..9;
DEFINE carry_out := (value = 9) & carry_in;
ASSIGN
  init(value) := 0;
  next(value) := case
    reset    : 0;
    carry_in : (value + 1) mod 10;
    TRUE     : value;
  esac;
-- d0.carry_in is always TRUE; d(i).carry_in := d(i-1).carry_out`,
  };

  let model = 'flipflop';
  let flip = false;
  let mod4 = 0;
  let digits = [0, 0, 0, 0, 0];
  let trace = [];

  function initialLabel() {
    if (model === 'flipflop') return 'x = FALSE';
    if (model === 'mod4') return 'x = 0';
    return '00000';
  }

  function reset() {
    flip = false;
    mod4 = 0;
    digits = [0, 0, 0, 0, 0];
    trace = [initialLabel()];
    document.getElementById('nb25-reset-ivar').checked = false;
    render();
  }

  function step() {
    if (model === 'flipflop') {
      flip = !flip;
      trace.push('x = ' + (flip ? 'TRUE' : 'FALSE'));
    } else if (model === 'mod4') {
      mod4 = (mod4 + 1) % 4;
      trace.push('x = ' + mod4);
    } else {
      const pushReset = document.getElementById('nb25-reset-ivar').checked;
      if (pushReset) {
        digits = [0, 0, 0, 0, 0];
      } else {
        let carry = true; // d0.carry_in is always TRUE
        for (let i = 0; i < digits.length; i++) {
          const carryIn = carry;
          carry = (digits[i] === 9) && carryIn; // carry_out, computed before update
          digits[i] = carryIn ? (digits[i] + 1) % 10 : digits[i];
        }
      }
      document.getElementById('nb25-reset-ivar').checked = false;
      trace.push((pushReset ? '[reset] ' : '') + digits.slice().reverse().join(''));
    }
    render();
  }

  function renderStateDisplay() {
    const el = document.getElementById('nb25-state-display');
    if (model === 'flipflop') {
      el.innerHTML = `<div class="sm-digits"><div class="sm-digit">${flip ? 'T' : 'F'}</div></div>`;
    } else if (model === 'mod4') {
      el.innerHTML = `<div class="sm-digits"><div class="sm-digit">${mod4}</div></div>`;
    } else {
      let html = '<div class="sm-digits">';
      for (let i = digits.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        html += `<div class="sm-digit">${digits[i]}</div>`;
      }
      html += '</div>';
      html += '<div style="font-size:0.8rem;color:var(--sm-label);">Read left to right as d&#8324;d&#8323;d&#8322;d&#8321;d&#8320; (most-significant digit first); d&#8320; is the least-significant digit and carries ripple left as digits wrap from 9 to 0.</div>';
      el.innerHTML = html;
    }
  }

  function render() {
    document.getElementById('nb25-code').textContent = CODE[model];
    document.getElementById('nb25-reset-ivar-wrap').style.display = model === 'mechcounter' ? 'flex' : 'none';
    renderStateDisplay();
    const traceEl = document.getElementById('nb25-trace');
    traceEl.innerHTML = '';
    trace.forEach(s => {
      const span = document.createElement('span');
      span.className = 'sm-trace-step';
      span.textContent = s;
      traceEl.appendChild(span);
    });
    traceEl.scrollTop = traceEl.scrollHeight;
  }

  document.querySelectorAll('#nb25-model-toggle button').forEach(b => {
    b.addEventListener('click', () => {
      model = b.dataset.model;
      document.querySelectorAll('#nb25-model-toggle button').forEach(x => x.classList.toggle('active', x === b));
      reset();
    });
  });
  document.getElementById('nb25-step').addEventListener('click', step);
  document.getElementById('nb25-reset').addEventListener('click', reset);

  reset();
})();
</script>
```

## What to try

1. **Flip-flop and modulo-4 counter** are both fully deterministic&mdash;every click has exactly one possible outcome, matching `ex:flipflop` and `sec:smv-mod4` in the chapter.
2. **Mechanical counter, no reset.** Click `Step` nine times and watch `d0` climb from `0` to `9`; on the tenth click, `d0` wraps to `0` and `carry_out` becomes true for one step, which is exactly what pushes `d1` from `0` to `1`. This is the carry-propagation logic from `sec:mech-counter` made visible one digit at a time.
3. **Push reset mid-count.** Tick "push `reset` on next step" after a few increments, then click `Step`&mdash;every digit snaps back to `0` in a single transition, exactly as `IVAR reset` is modelled: an environment input, unconstrained until the moment you choose its value.
